summary.whatChanges: Fixes `makeResource`/`makeAsyncResource` so a pre-existing `Symbol.dispose`/`Symbol.asyncDispose` method is invoked with the object as `this` (via `.call(it)`) instead of unbound. Adds unit tests covering `this` preservation and disposing an async generator with a native async dispose.
behaviorChanges: Disposing a wrapped resource now calls its original dispose/asyncDispose method bound to the object, so methods relying on `this` work correctly
Async generators with native Symbol.asyncDispose (Bun, Node 24+) can be disposed without throwing, and their `finally` cleanup runs
New tests added for the disposable stream utility
risks: Existing dispose implementations that previously ran unbound (undefined `this`) will now receive the wrapper object, which could alter their behavior
Rebinding invokes the original method on the mutated wrapper `it`, which now has an overwritten dispose symbol — potential for unexpected self-reference in custom implementations
